newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN T-BILL TRADE - 928 BLN RBLS TRANSFERRED.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN T-BILL TRADE - 928 BLN RBLS TRANSFERRED.

text.p: Government securities dealers had transferred 928 billion roubles ($159.7 million) to their accounts on the government securities trading system before the market opened on Friday, the central bank's open-market operations department said.

Only money transferred to trading accounts before the market opens at 11 a.m. (0700 GMT) is available for investing in paper that day and is an indication of potential demand for GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds.

The total limit for short positions available to dealers licensed to conduct repo operations remains 2.00 trillion roubles. The rate for repos taken out on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday remains at 18 percent and for repos taken out on Thursday and Friday at 21 percent. Repos taken out on Friday will expire on August 12.
Details of the last few days' transfers and the central bank's net intervention in the market a week ago, can be seen on page CBGKOINF.
